name: Sebastian Ehmann
abstract_title: Predictors of Altered Consciousness and Self-Transcendent Perceptual Dynamics in a Naturalistic Psychedelic Retreat Study
abstract: Psychedelic compounds have re-emerged as a major scientific focus due to their pronounced effects on consciousness and therapeutic potential across multiple mental health conditions. Evidence suggests that their consciousness-altering properties are central to clinical effects, facilitating salutogenic experiences that promote psychological change and longer-term well-being.
